title: Missing rubric columns produce misaligned new-flag values
reasoning: Fallback Series use a fresh RangeIndex, while filtering by problem and display name preserves the original dataframe index. Pandas aligns subtraction and assignment by index. If either rubric column is absent, rows outside the fallback index receive NaN instead of the intended zero-based calculation, silently removing or corrupting the New Rubric Flags trace.
reproduction: Provide a selected problem whose rows retain indices 10 and 11, with rubric_total_flags present and rubric_carried_over absent. The resulting _new_flags values are NaN instead of the total flag counts.
recommendation: Construct fallback Series with index=run_df.index, or use scalar zero defaults where appropriate.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No supplied test exercises the problem comparison chart, optional rubric columns, or filtered dataframe indices.
suggestedRegressionTest: Test missing combinations of rubric columns using noncontiguous indices and verify new-flag values remain aligned with their checkpoints.
